command: $files = @('CMakeLists.txt','.forge-codex/state/decisions/P16-008-closed-dashboard-application-dispatch-and-json-boundary.md','include/ForgeConductor/Application/DashboardConnectionApplication.h','include/ForgeConductor/Dashboard/DashboardApplicationErrorMapper.h','include/ForgeConductor/Dashboard/DashboardApplicationJsonCodec.h','include/ForgeConductor/Dashboard/DashboardApplicationModels.h','include/ForgeConductor/Dashboard/DashboardSessionCloseRequest.h','include/ForgeConductor/Dashboard/DashboardSessionCloseRequestDecoder.h','include/ForgeConductor/Dashboard/IDashboardOperationalService.h','include/ForgeConductor/Dashboard/IDashboardTelemetrySource.h','src/Application/DashboardConnectionApplication.cpp','src/Dashboard/DashboardApplicationErrorMapper.cpp','src/Dashboard/DashboardApplicationJsonCodec.cpp','src/Dashboard/DashboardSessionCloseRequestDecoder.cpp','tests/Application/DashboardConnectionApplicationTests.cpp','tests/Dashboard/DashboardApplicationErrorMapperTests.cpp','tests/Dashboard/DashboardApplicationJsonCodecTests.cpp','tests/Dashboard/DashboardSessionCloseRequestDecoderTests.cpp'); $utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true); foreach ($file in $files) { $bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path (Get-Location) $file)); if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) { throw "UTF-8 BOM found: $file" }; $text = $utf8.GetString($bytes); if ($text -match '(?<!\r)\n' -or $text -match '\r(?!\n)') { throw "Non-CRLF line ending found: $file" }; if (-not $text.EndsWith("`r`n")) { throw "Missing final CRLF: $file" } }; Write-Output "CRLF UTF-8 no-BOM validation passed for $($files.Count) files."
